entries.headline: Russian strikes on Kyiv and Odesa report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a BBC report of major Russian strikes on Kyiv and Odesa after Russia said it was ready in principle to resume peace talks.

entries.headline: Starlink disruptions investigation call highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed a Stars and Stripes report that lawmakers called for an investigation into the source of Starlink disruptions in Ukraine.

entries.headline: North Atlantic and UK military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported four coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts that day, along with multiple large transport aircraft and a NATO surveillance jet over the North Atlantic and United Kingdom region.

entries.headline: Tal al-Hawa vehicle-strike report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report that two people were killed and several injured in an Israeli airstrike on a vehicle in Tal al-Hawa. The post said three outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: 252-body repatriation report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted a Suspilne report that Ukraine received the bodies of 252 people which the Russian side claimed belonged to Ukrainian citizens, including service members. The post said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: North Sea and UK military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. Air Force transport aircraft and a surveillance aircraft over the North Sea and United Kingdom, along with three coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts heard earlier that day.

entries.headline: U.S., North Sea and Baltic military-flight activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported six U.S. Air Force transport aircraft over the continental United States and North Sea, with military-flight activity near the Baltic at nearly four times the usual level.

entries.headline: IRGC oil-transfer vessel report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch highlighted an Al Jazeera Arabic report concerning four ships transferring oil from one vessel, and said two outlets had confirmed the report.

entries.headline: U.S. and North Sea military-aircraft activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported multiple U.S. military surveillance and airborne-command aircraft over the United States and North Sea, along with three coded U.S. Air Force radio broadcasts that day.

entries.headline: Haiti hostage-rescue operation report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Associated Press report that Nayib Bukele said a military operation was launched to rescue Salvadorans held by gangs in Haiti.

entries.headline: Russia-Ukraine three-way talks report highlighted
entries.summary: War Watch relayed an Associated Press report that the Kremlin said Russia agreed to resume three-way talks with Ukraine and the United States on the war in Ukraine.

entries.headline: COBRA45 RC-135S sighting reported
entries.summary: War Watch reported COBRA45, a Boeing RC-135S Cobra Ball with hex code AE01D6 and registration 61-2663. The sighting was credited to reagan0965 and the photo to Sierra Aviation Photography via Planespotters.net.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: N333QS North Las Vegas arrival replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a one-take replay of N333QS, a Phenom 300, flying from Van Nuys to North Las Vegas and continuing from the valley to touchdown and back.

entries.headline: Harry Reid ramp aircraft counts shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported 38 aircraft on one Harry Reid ramp and 26 on another on Wednesday morning during NBAA-BACE, shown in four frames from the valley to the ramp.

entries.headline: KLAS show-week ramp tour shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a continuous tour of the KLAS ramp, noting that show-week ground activity becomes difficult after aircraft land.

entries.headline: Las Vegas Strip helicopter replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 120-times-speed replay of Tuesday evening helicopter tours operating from Harry Reid International Airport, along the Las Vegas Strip and back.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of NBAA-BACE day-one peak traffic covering KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU, followed by a whole-valley view.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE Tuesday traffic comparison posted
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported Las Vegas valley traffic down 9% and business-jet traffic down 19% on Tuesday, October 20, compared with Monday, based on SkyGlass MCP data.

entries.headline: Las Vegas valley traffic peak replay shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a 30-times-speed replay of the previous day’s peak traffic across four Las Vegas-area airfields.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE day-one traffic view shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass presented a day-one NBAA-BACE live view covering four Las Vegas-area airfields, with valley-wide views and closer views of KLAS and KHND.

entries.headline: NBAA-BACE traffic after-action report shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass reported that Las Vegas valley traffic on 19 October was down 4% while business-jet activity held steady. The post credited the data to the SkyGlass MCP.

entries.headline: NetJets Citation Latitude arrival at KHND shown
entries.summary: SkyGlass showed NetJets Citation Latitude N910QS arriving from Denver Centennial and parking on the ramp at KHND, with ramp movements marked across the sequence.

entries.headline: BACE ramp boards launched for four Las Vegas fields
entries.summary: SkyGlass announced live ramp boards for KLAS, KHND, KVGT and KBVU during BACE show week.

entries.headline: N200SG field view and airframe brief shared
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a field view and an Airframe Intelligence Brief for Falcon 50 N200SG.
